subject: Prospective HCI PhD applicant (Fall 2027): question about fit
body:
Dear Prof. Li,

My name is Avery Santos. I'm a senior in Computer Science at Brookfield University, and I'm applying to the Khoury HCI PhD program for Fall 2027. I'm writing to ask whether my interests might fit your lab.

Since 2025 I've been an undergraduate research assistant in Prof. A. Moreno's Social Computing Lab, supporting an interview study about how teens use online communities for mental-health support. Through that work I've become curious about how automated moderation, like word filters that remove posts, affects what teens feel safe saying when they're looking for help.

Your homepage says privacy sustains "safe exploration, and free expression," and that felt close to the question I keep coming back to. My own background is much less in privacy than in qualitative work with sensitive data, including de-identifying interview transcripts by hand.

I know moderation isn't a central topic in your lab, so I'd really appreciate your honest sense of whether a student with these interests could fit your group, or whether you'd recommend other faculty I should look at.

Thank you for your time.

Best,
Avery Santos
B.S. Computer Science (minor in Data Science), Brookfield University, expected May 2027
avery.santos@example.edu
